liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (2 reviews): The reviewer remembers Foolish Heart as ascendant, with a good atmosphere; Reviewer calls Foolish Heart heavenly [25][26]
- **Bertha** (1 review): In Bertha, Jerry sings a line about a whale house, perhaps meaning wail house [30]
- **Row jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer especially enjoys the flute-like sound in Row Jimmy [27]

## Setlist highlights

- **Quality Is About A For The Most Part(Subjective Of Course).Nice Crisp And Clear Sound**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [36]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-11.nak.boedicker.116122.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 149 min [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader describes the sound as crisp and clear, of good quality [1]
- **gd92-06-11.sbd.ladner.8069.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 146 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard has great sound quality [27]
- **gd1992-06-11.sbd.miller.90105.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 147 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the soundboard quality as great; Excellent audio reveals plenty of Vince in vocals and mix; Bob and Phil sit modestly back, Jerry prominent [30][32]
- **gd1992-06-11.154484.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 146 min [4]
- **gd1992-06-11.152717.sbd.miller.flac2448**: soundboard; 18 songs; 146 min [5]
- **gd1992-06-11.nakcm300.andrewf.86035.flac1648**: source not stated; 18 songs; 149 min [9]. Said about its sound: PA mix problems are present at the start of Bertha [9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's brother accidentally threw a day-glo frisbee that struck Jerry below the knee; Jerry shrugged it off and kept playing [25]
- Reviewer finds the pace unhurried, letting every player stand out; Jerry's phrasing and clarity are notably adept [32]
- Reviewer says the show featured Hornsby prominently [35]
- Calls the first set great and one of the last great Knickerbocker shows; second set shorter and fairly stock [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-11.nak.boedicker.116122.flac16**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source:Sony D6 Cassette Master(Dolby B On)>Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck(Playback,Dolby Off)>Cd Wav Editor>Traders Little… [1]. Also: Nakamichi-sourced recording by Boedicker; a tape flip falls after Queen Jane Approximately, with no music missed before Dire Wolf [1]
- **gd92-06-11.sbd.ladner.8069.sbeok.shnf**: source: sbd> dat> cass> dat> cdr> wav> shnv3 [2]
- **gd1992-06-11.sbd.miller.90105.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) D [3]
- **gd1992-06-11.154484.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 23, 2021; source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [4]
- **gd1992-06-11.152717.sbd.miller.flac2448**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 23, 2021; source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [5]
- **gd1992-06-11.nakcm300.andrewf.86035.flac1648**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Casio DA-7 > Sony DG-Dat tape. Mics on 7-foot stand in OTS. [9]. Also: Taped and transferred in June 2007 by Andrew F., using Soundforge for fades and TLH for FLAC [9]

claims.text: The reviewer remembers Foolish Heart as ascendant, with a good atmosphere
Reviewer's brother accidentally threw a day-glo frisbee that struck Jerry below the knee; Jerry shrugged it off and kept playing
Calls the first set great and one of the last great Knickerbocker shows; second set shorter and fairly stock
Reviewer especially enjoys the flute-like sound in Row Jimmy
Reviewer says the soundboard has great sound quality
In Bertha, Jerry sings a line about a whale house, perhaps meaning wail house
Reviewer describes the soundboard quality as great
Excellent audio reveals plenty of Vince in vocals and mix; Bob and Phil sit modestly back, Jerry prominent
Reviewer finds the pace unhurried, letting every player stand out; Jerry's phrasing and clarity are notably adept
Reviewer says the show featured Hornsby prominently
Nakamichi-sourced recording by Boedicker; a tape flip falls after Queen Jane Approximately, with no music missed before Dire Wolf
Uploader describes the sound as crisp and clear, of good quality
Soundboard recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; DAT to cassette transfer by Dick Latvala
Soundboard recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; Dick Latvala transferred DAT to cassette
Taped and transferred in June 2007 by Andrew F., using Soundforge for fades and TLH for FLAC
PA mix problems are present at the start of Bertha
